title: Concept: Stack trace or debug error printed (python) — review required
description: In python, traceback.print_excs*(s*) serializes internals into an error channel. Attackers harvest traces for reconnaissance before deeper attacks. The remedy is generic user errors plus a correlation-id log call.
applicability: python error paths; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Reconnaissance disclosure; LOW severity, higher on public endpoints.
